description: NaLaWFeO₆ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.95 Å. La is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.82 Å. W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-33°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.09 Å. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-33°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.23 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent La, one W, and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OLa₂FeW tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent La, one W, and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OLa₂FeW trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one La, one W, and one Fe atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one La, one W, and one Fe atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent La, one W, and one Fe atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one W, and one Fe atom.
